xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3291: bug(state): push-race reconciler wedges permanently on records/*.json content conflicts — state pushes fail forever until manual merge

plan.title: bug(state): push-race reconciler wedges permanently on records/*.json content conflicts — state pushes fail forever until manual merge
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: The record write door's push-race reconciler (reconcileStatePush, src/lib/pan-dir/record-update.ts:274) rebases local state commits onto origin/overdeck-state and can only auto-resolve a conflict when the sole conflicted path is the current issue's record. With N local unpushed commits, one poisoned intermediate commit (e.g. another issue's restore checkpoint) aborts the rebase identically on every attempt — a permanent wedge. Each failed cycle adds another restore checkpoint, so divergence only grows (74 ahead / 44 behind on 2026-07-29) until an operator performs a manual merge. Nothing surfaces the wedge while it compounds.
narratives.Proposal: Replace the reconcile rebase with a single 3-way merge of origin into the local state branch, with a deterministic conflict policy: conflicts confined to records/ auto-resolve (origin wins; the actively-written record is re-derived by replaying the caller's mutator so current truth wins); any other conflict aborts the merge cleanly. Track a per-project consecutive reconcile-failure streak in a runtime-plane push-health file; on crossing 3 failures emit one self-contained error activity entry (dashboard needs-you). Add a pan doctor check reporting state-branch ahead/behind, streak, and last failure per migrated project.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to the legacy unmigrated main-branch state push path (pushOriginMain / rebaseLegacyMainAndRetry in auto-commit.ts)
- No reconcile logic in the auto-commit queue itself (PAN-2541 D10: the paths-only queue never replays or rebases)
- No auto-resolution of conflicts outside records/ (specs/, drafts/, continues/ conflicts remain human-resolved)
- No .gitattributes merge driver for records
- No push-health wiring into plain non-reconcile push successes
- No new dashboard UI surface beyond the activity entry
- No retroactive repair of already-diverged machines (doctor's fix string documents the manual merge)

autoDecisions.summary: Merge-based reconcile chosen over keeping rebase (issue offered either)
autoDecisions.rationale: A merge is one 3-way resolution regardless of how many local commits accumulated, so a poisoned intermediate commit structurally cannot wedge it; matches the operator recovery precedent (b115fb6b2b, d902f8fea3).

autoDecisions.summary: Take-origin-then-replay-mutator chosen over regenerate-from-canonical for the actively-written record
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names this the cheaper option and the write door already owns mutator replay (existing replayConflictedRecord pattern).

autoDecisions.summary: Conflict policy in reconciler code, not a .gitattributes merge driver
autoDecisions.rationale: A custom driver requires per-clone merge.<name>.driver config that silently disappears when the state worktree is recreated; code is self-contained and testable.

autoDecisions.summary: Failure streak persisted in ${OVERDECK_HOME}/push-health/<stateWorktreeBasename>.json via a new push-health module
autoDecisions.rationale: Must not live on the state branch (the failing transport) nor require the server's SQLite (write door runs in CLI processes); a tiny atomic local file is the runtime plane's simplest durable option.

autoDecisions.summary: Needs-you threshold = 3 consecutive failed reconcileStatePush calls, emitted once on crossing via emitActivityEntry with new source 'state-door'
autoDecisions.rationale: Aligned with MAX_STATE_PUSH_RECONCILIATIONS; emit-on-crossing avoids alert spam while divergence persists.

autoDecisions.summary: Delete/modify conflicts on records are NOT auto-resolved; reconcile aborts
autoDecisions.rationale: Records are essentially never deleted, so a deletion conflict is anomalous — safety over cleverness.

autoDecisions.summary: For conflicted records other than the one being written, origin wins even if local had unpushed mutations
autoDecisions.rationale: records/*.json are re-derivable full-file mirrors regenerated on every write; they self-heal on their next write-door update (stated in the issue and confirmed by the incident recovery).

items.title: Add bounded abortMerge cleanup alongside abortRebase in every record-durability cleanup path

expected_outputs: record-update.test.ts passes including the new mid-merge cleanup test

narrative.Action: Add abortMerge(gitRoot, options) next to abortRebase (record-update.ts:173): git merge --abort with timeoutMs 5000, swallowing errors. Call it immediately after every existing abortRebase call site — restoreRetryableRecord (record-update.ts:230) and the reconcile onTimeout cleanup (record-update.ts:370) — keeping abortRebase in place. See PRD work item 1.

items.title: Given a state worktree stranded mid-merge with conflicts, when restoreRetryableRecord runs, then git status reports no in-progress merge and the record file contains the restored snapshot
abortMerge bounds its git subprocess to a 5s timeout and returns without throwing when no merge is in progress

After a durability-deadline abort fires during a conflicted reconcile, the state worktree exits any in-progress merge or rebase within the bounded cleanup and preserves the record file in a retryable state
Replace reconcile rebase with 3-way merge plus deterministic records/ conflict policy

expected_outputs: record-reconcile.test.ts passes: two-writer convergence, poisoned-commit, non-records abort, delete/modify abort

narrative.Action: In reconcileStatePush (record-update.ts:283-313): swap `git rebase origin/${STATE_BRANCH}` for `git merge --no-edit origin/${STATE_BRANCH}`; on conflict run new resolveMergeConflicts (replaces replayConflictedRecord, which is deleted): list conflicts via diff --name-only --diff-filter=U; throw if any path is outside records/; resolve each conflicted record with git checkout --theirs + git add (throw on checkout failure = delete/modify, per D6); if the actively-written record conflicted, replay the mutator on the origin version through readIssueRecordSync/writeIssueRecordSync and re-add (mirrors record-update.ts:200-216); conclude with `git -c core.editor=true commit --no-edit`. On resolve failure: abortMerge + abortRebase then throw the reconcile error. Run abortMerge+abortRebase once at reconcile start to recover crash-stranded worktrees. Push retry loop unchanged. All git steps take { signal }; throwIfDurabilityAborted between synchronous mutations. CAUTION (hazard H1): during this merge, --theirs = origin. Follow PRD work item 2 exactly, including the before/after snippet.

items.title: Given two clones that both mutated the same records/<issue>.json from a shared base and clone B pushed first, when clone A's updateIssueRecord runs, then it returns successfully and origin's final record contains A's mutation applied on top of B's pushed version

Given a local state branch 3+ commits ahead including an intermediate commit that content-conflicts with origin (another issue's restore checkpoint), when the next updateIssueRecord runs, then reconcile completes in that single call and the branch pushes with ahead count 0
After a successful reconcile, origin history contains no 'restore ... after failed state push' checkpoint from the converging write
Given a merge conflict on a specs/ path, when reconcile runs, then updateIssueRecord rejects with an error naming the conflicted path and the state worktree shows no in-progress merge afterwards
Given a delete/modify conflict on a records/ path, when reconcile runs, then it aborts the merge and rejects rather than auto-resolving
Add push-health runtime-plane module tracking consecutive reconcile failures per project

expected_outputs: push-health.test.ts passes: increment, reset, threshold-crossing-once, corrupt-file default, atomic write

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/pan-dir/push-health.ts owning ${OVERDECK_HOME}/push-health/<stateWorktreeBasename>.json (key = basename(resolveStateReadHomeSync(project).root)). Exports: readPushHealth(project) returning a zeroed default for missing/corrupt files; recordReconcileFailure(project, { reason, conflictedPaths }) returning { health, crossedThreshold } where crossedThreshold is true only when the streak moves from 2 to 3; recordReconcileSuccess(project) resetting the streak and stamping lastSuccessAt; RECONCILE_FAILURE_NEEDS_YOU_THRESHOLD = 3. Writes are sync fs, tmp-file + renameSync (NFR-4, PAN-2623 zero-byte precedent). Fields per PRD work item 3: consecutiveReconcileFailures, lastFailureAt, lastFailureReason, lastConflictedPaths, lastSuccessAt.

items.title: recordReconcileFailure persists an incremented streak that survives across separate calls, and recordReconcileSuccess returns the persisted streak to 0 and persists lastSuccessAt
crossedThreshold returns true exactly once when the streak reaches 3 and returns false at 4 and beyond
readPushHealth returns a zeroed default when the file is missing, empty, or contains invalid JSON
Writes produce the target file via temp-file-then-rename, so a crash before the rename preserves the previous file contents intact
Record reconcile outcomes in push-health and emit the threshold needs-you activity entry

expected_outputs: record-reconcile.test.ts passes the streak/emission scenarios: exactly one state-door error entry at 3 failures, nothing at 4, reset on success

narrative.Action: Add 'state-door' to the ActivitySource union (src/lib/activity-logger.ts:22). In reconcileStatePush: call recordReconcileFailure on any throw (conflict-resolution failure or attempts-exhausted, with reason + conflicted paths when known) and recordReconcileSuccess on the successful push return. When crossedThreshold is true, emit the error-level emitActivityEntry with source 'state-door' using the self-contained operator message from PRD work item 4 (names project, conflicted paths, streak, points at pan doctor and the manual merge). Health/emission failures are console.warn'd and never mask the original reconcile error (hazard H5). Test with setActivityEventStoreProvider (activity-logger.ts:89) capture.

items.title: Given 3 consecutive updateIssueRecord calls that fail reconcile on a non-records conflict, then exactly one activity entry with source 'state-door' and level 'error' is emitted, and its details name the conflicted path
A 4th consecutive failure emits no additional activity entry, and a subsequent successful reconcile resets the persisted streak to 0
When push-health persistence or activity emission itself throws, updateIssueRecord still rejects with the original reconcile error message
Add pan doctor state-divergence check (ahead/behind, streak, last failure)

expected_outputs: doctor-state-divergence.test.ts passes: ok/warn/error mapping and offline-stale path
lint (including lint-skills) passes without changes to pan doctor --help

narrative.Action: Create src/cli/commands/doctor-state-divergence.ts exporting checkStateDivergence(projects = listProjectsSync()) with the same check shape as checkStateWorktrees (doctor-state-worktree.ts). Per migrated project: bounded 10s `git fetch origin overdeck-state` (on failure flag counts as stale instead of erroring), `git rev-list --left-right --count overdeck-state...origin/overdeck-state` for ahead/behind, readPushHealth for streak + lastFailureReason. Status: error if streak >= 3; warn if streak >= 1 or ahead >= 10; else ok. fix string documents the manual same-branch merge in the state worktree. Wire `checks.push(...await checkStateDivergence())` next to doctor.ts:851. Async execFile only — no execSync.

items.title: Against a converged temp state worktree, checkStateDivergence returns ok with ahead/behind counts rendered in the message
With a seeded push-health streak of 3, the check returns error and the message includes the streak and last failure reason; with ahead >= 10 and streak 0 it returns warn
With an unreachable origin, the check still returns a result whose message labels the counts stale instead of throwing
Running pan doctor renders the new per-project state-divergence rows in its output after the state-worktree checks
Document the merge-based reconcile policy, escalation threshold, and doctor check

expected_outputs: lint passes; STATE-PLANE-COMMIT-POLICY.md contains the reconcile conflict policy, threshold, push-health file location, and doctor check description

narrative.Action: Update docs/STATE-PLANE-COMMIT-POLICY.md push section (~lines 22-31) so it states: the record write door reconciles push races by merging origin/overdeck-state into the local branch; conflicts confined to records/ auto-resolve with origin winning and the actively-written record replaying its mutation; other conflicts abort and count toward a 3-strike error activity entry; the push-health file path/shape; and that pan doctor reports ahead/behind + streak. Add one paragraph in docs/AGENT-STATE-PLANES.md's durability section (~line 30) linking to that policy. Check the doctor wrapper skill under skills/ and update only if it enumerates individual checks (pan doctor --help is unchanged).

items.title: STATE-PLANE-COMMIT-POLICY.md describes the records/-only auto-resolution rule, the 3-failure escalation, and the push-health file location so an operator can act on a doctor error without reading source
AGENT-STATE-PLANES.md's durability section renders a markdown link to the reconcile policy section of STATE-PLANE-COMMIT-POLICY.md
